brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Create exactly ONE finished image, landscape 16:9, target 1536×864 or larger. Not a photo.

Style: match the approved black-and-lime ink illustration reference viewed in this conversation. Deep charcoal #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brushstrokes, warm ivory typography, hand-drawn black/ivory ink hatching with restrained natural skin tones. Very bold readable Japanese headline, sparse elements, powerful movement. Do not copy any player, name, statistic or date from the style reference.

Subject: EXACTLY TWO real professional basketball players, never fictional substitute athletes. They are chosen at random from the two main teams' current official rosters; their presence represents only an imagined matchup, not evidence of actual participation or a real game event.
1. Keyontae Johnson (キヨンテ・ジョンソン), Alvark Tokyo: based on the official portrait just viewed, dark brown skin, short textured black tapered natural curls with a slightly taller rounded top, broad strong angular face, focused almond eyes under defined brows, broad nose, full lips, fine mustache and small trimmed chin goatee, muscular broad shoulders. Plain black sleeveless uniform with a narrow red edge, no letters, no number, no symbols. Keep face recognizably Johnson, not Jarrett Culver from the style image.
2. Jake Layman (ジェイク・レイマン), Sendai: based on the official portrait just viewed, fair skin, elongated narrow face and long straight nose, light eyes, short light-brown hair neatly swept back/up with a side part, clean-shaven, lean tall build. Plain muted yellow sleeveless uniform with charcoal edge, no letters, no number, no symbols. Keep face recognizably Layman.
Official appearance sources: https://www.alvark-tokyo.jp/player_lp/keyontae_johnson/ and https://www.89ers.jp/team/players/detail/id=21448?PlayerID=51000313 . These are appearance references only. Do not paste or reuse photographic pixels.

Composition: left 49% clean typography, right 51% an energetic invented one-on-one basketball illustration. Johnson in the foreground leaning into a drive, controlling one orange basketball with his right hand at waist height, his face three-quarter visible. Taller Layman slightly farther right in a defensive stance, face three-quarter visible, knees bent, one open hand reaching laterally toward the dribble, other hand open near shoulder. Keep their arms distinct, both faces unobstructed, natural human anatomy, each visible hand with plausible fingers. Crop around upper thighs intentionally; keep heads, hands and the complete ball inside the canvas with margin. The figures may partially overlap each other but never the headline. No hoop, no scoreboard, no crowd, no third person. Diagonal lime dry-brush movement behind figures. Show expressive manual ink lines, visibly illustrated rather than photographic.

Render only these exact Japanese texts, no other text:
Small top-left: 「バスケまとめ」
Adjacent small readable badge: 「試合前展望」
Largest stacked headline on left: 「1勝差の」 then 「首位攻防」
Below headline in bold ivory: 「A東京 × 仙台」
Date below: 「11/6 19:05」
Small but clearly legible source qualifier immediately under date: 「順位は11/1終了時点」
Bottom left in highly readable ivory: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 followed by 「イメージ」
Use Japanese gothic typography with heavy weight; headline may have subtle brush texture but no broken strokes. Exact characters and numerals, strong hierarchy, no collisions, all text inside at least 4% safe margins. '1勝差' means team standings difference, not a score; do not imply a final result.

Editorial grounding ONLY the supplied frozen article: A東京 and 仙台 are one win apart at end of Nov 1; Nov 6 at 19:05 is a previewed game. Do not add any result, win prediction, player names, appearances or player statistics in the image. Do not portray this as a recreation of an actual game scene. Visible labels 試合前展望 and イメージ must remain. No official team logo, league logo, sponsorship, jersey lettering, watermark or photorealism.

CORRECTION 1 (ONLY CORRECTION)
Edit the first input image, the complete black/lime basketball thumbnail. The second input is Keyontae Johnson's OFFICIAL PORTRAIT and the third is Jake Layman's OFFICIAL PORTRAIT. Use both portraits solely as anatomical likeness references, never paste their photographic pixels. Keep a clearly hand-inked illustration. This is the one permitted correction pass.

Fix two problems precisely:
1. Improve both actual players' likeness to the provided portraits. Johnson (foreground in black) must have the SHORT compact natural black curls and taper of portrait 2, NOT the tall fluffy long curls in the first thumbnail. He has a broad, slightly rectangular face, forward-set focused almond eyes, a straight broad nose, full lips, a very thin neat mustache and a small narrow chin goatee; eliminate the full heavy jawline beard. Keep broad muscular shoulders and the active driving pose. Do not depict Jarrett Culver or a generic player. Layman (defender in yellow) must have portrait 3's longer narrow face, longer straight narrow nose, lighter eyes, very short light-brown side hair, top swept UP AND BACK with a side part, and clean-shaven cheeks and chin with no beard. Keep an alert defensive expression.
2. Reframe the entire TWO-player illustration slightly smaller and shifted DOWN/LEFT within its right-hand area so Layman's WHOLE HAIR silhouette has at least 35 pixels of dark background above it and the rightmost extended hand has at least 35 pixels of breathing room from the right edge. Both heads, all visible hands, and the entire orange basketball must be inside the canvas. Natural hands, no extra digits or fused fingers. The whole ball already fits; keep it that way. Do not obscure any text. Make Layman's near reaching arm anatomically readable and do not create a third player.

Preserve ALL existing text exactly, typography hierarchy, relative text positions, dark #151A18 + lime #CCF43B brush style, orange ball, black-and-red plain uniform for Johnson, plain yellow/charcoal uniform for Layman, and the imagined one-on-one action. All uniforms stay completely unbranded without letters, names, numbers, logos or sponsors.
The visible text must remain:
バスケまとめ
試合前展望
1勝差の
首位攻防
A東京 × 仙台
11/6 19:05
順位は11/1終了時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Keep all text legible with a small safe outer margin, no clipping.
No player names, player statistics, final scores or actual-game claims. No photography, official logos, watermark, arena details or added elements. Exactly one finished landscape 16:9 thumbnail, at least 1536 pixels wide.
